repomix.user_provided_header: Unified Authentication, Hardening & Single Sign-On (task.txt & execution.txt): Complete backend and frontend bundle for multi-actor unified login (Admin, Cashier, Supplier, Retail Customer, Wholesale Customer) including security hardening against timing attacks (constant 3x bcrypt check with dummy hashes), normalized identifier rate limiting, case-insensitive functional indexes for PostgreSQL, foreign key restrictions, handoff role rechecking, and safe redirection guards. Contains all services, controllers, requests, resources, cross-table unique validation rules, updated routes and deprecated endpoints, demo seeder, models, factories, feature and unit tests (UnifiedLoginTest, UnifiedLoginHardeningTest, EmailUniquenessTest, AdminAuthEndpointsTest), shared api-client endpoints and types, Next.js storefront auth screens and stores, and Backoffice Vite/React auth callback and guards.
